list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, with names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.
missableRule: Flags are tied to the official descriptions and come in two tiers. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: the description itself can be permanently failed — a silver that needs eight stranger strands finished, when any one strand can be left behind, and a trophy that demands success on a second attempt, which a flawless first attempt destroys. WATCH: the five stranger-strand finales, which the story can move past if a strand is left unfinished. Everything else on the list can be earned in free roam after the story, so it carries no flag.

roadmap.title: Prologue and Chapter 1 — learn the ropes
roadmap.rationale: The opening mission and Chapter 1 are unmissable story beats, so the run starts here. Sample every activity type as it unlocks: Master of None only asks for a first try at each, and early sampling spreads several long counters across the whole game.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2 to 4 — the named missions
roadmap.rationale: Push the main thread through Chapters 2, 3 and 4, collecting the named mission trophies (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) as they arrive in the story sequence.

roadmap.title: Strangers of Leonida — finish every strand
roadmap.rationale: The missable heart of the list. Each stranger's strand ends in a finale mission, and those finales carry the watch flags: finish Andy's, Kenton's, Billy's, Randy's and Tyrone's strands promptly as they appear, complete eight strands in all, and take Bret's hunt while you are among the strangers.

roadmap.title: The final mission — and the one deliberate failure
roadmap.rationale: With the strands tied off, play the final mission for the gold story trophy. Bad Luck, I Guess belongs to this stretch of the run: its description demands success on a second attempt, so when its event offers a retry, fail once on purpose instead of reloading for a flawless run.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges — the scored clean-up
roadmap.rationale: Everything scored and repeatable: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone race wins at all 14 locations, 20 race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, an arcade game, 50 challenges, bowling, and the two combat feats that fit naturally in free-roam fights.

roadmap.title: The collection sweep — cards, spots and vehicles
roadmap.rationale: The map-wide counters: 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, meditation at all 18 spots, all 52 areas explored, 100 vehicles discovered and 10 registered, all 8 garages bought, and the two money totals ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent) that a long run mostly fills by itself.

roadmap.title: One-off feats and the crime spree
roadmap.rationale: The staged moments, all repeatable in free roam: the partner wanted-level escape and the three-shop robbery chain, the unscheduled VCIA departure, the Rhino encounter, the undetected jewelry robbery, 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, and the small scene trophies (cocktail, showroom, partnership moment, choices, the strange encounter).

roadmap.title: 100 percent — and the platinum
roadmap.rationale: Check the in-game completion counter and mop up whichever category still owes percentage; A Long Road pops at 100 percent, and the platinum follows automatically the moment the 54th other trophy is earned.

steps.text: The platinum is not a task of its own: it is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies on the list are earned.
Work the roadmap in order — story and stranger strands first, then the activity, collectible and feat clean-up — so the flagged trophies are settled while they are easy to reach.
Use the progress header as the scoreboard: when it reads 54 of 55 earned, this is the only trophy left and it pops on its own.
Start a new game and play Gone Fishing, the opening mission the story begins with.
Play the mission through to its end; the trophy pops at the conclusion, before the open world fully opens up.
It cannot be skipped or failed permanently, so every platinum run starts with this trophy in hand.
Follow Chapter 1's mission markers in order from the opening mission onward.
The trophy unlocks as the chapter closes; no side content is required before it.
Detours cost nothing — story progress is never lost by wandering — but finishing the chapter is what opens the map up.
Continue the main thread into Chapter 2 once Chapter 1 has closed.
Complete the chapter's story missions in sequence; the trophy pops on the chapter's final mission.
Keep stranger strands moving alongside the chapters — several open during this stretch and they carry the watch flags.
Play Chapter 3's story missions in sequence, following the main thread.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end, exactly as the two chapter trophies before it did.
If it has not popped, a chapter mission is still outstanding: the chapter trophies unlock strictly in order, which makes the list itself a progress check.
Finish Chapter 4, the last of the numbered chapters before the endgame.
Complete its story missions in order; the trophy unlocks as the chapter concludes and the road to the final mission opens.
Before going further, tie off any stranger strands you still owe — the endgame is where unfinished strands get left behind.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Complete the final mission of the story; this is the list's story gold.
Before starting it, finish the stranger strands flagged on the watch list, so nothing is left hanging past the story's point of no return.
The trophy pops as the final mission concludes.
Everything repeatable — activities, collectibles, feats — can still be cleaned up in free roam afterwards, so only the flagged items are urgent here.
Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it arrives on the main story thread.
Named missions like this one are handed out in story sequence, so steady story progress is the whole method.
The trophy unlocks on completion — nothing beyond finishing the mission is asked.
Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the named story missions.
Play it as part of the main story sequence; a heist trophy like this asks for the job finished, nothing more exotic.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
Complete Child's Play, a named mission on the main story thread.
Follow the story until the mission appears, then finish it.
The trophy pops at the mission's results screen.
Complete Headliners, one of the named story missions.
It sits on the main thread: progress the story, finish the mission, and the trophy unlocks.
No optional condition is attached to it in the official list.
Complete VCIA Takedown, a named mission in the main story thread.
VCIA is the airport authority the story puts you up against, so expect the mission around the airport's operations.
Complete it as it comes and the trophy is yours.
Complete Operation Savage Glory, another named story mission on the main thread.
Finish it in story sequence; there is no side requirement in the official description.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
Reach 100 percent completion as the game itself measures it — not a count of trophies, but the game's own completion figure.
That figure spans the story, the stranger strands, and broad completion across activities, collectibles and challenges.
The in-game completion counter is the authority: read it to see which category still owes you percentage, and mop that category up.
Together with the platinum, this is the last trophy of a full run; it pops the moment the counter reaches 100.
Complete 250 stunts — the total is stated in the official description itself.
Stunt opportunities — ramps, jumps and set-piece moments — are scattered across Leonida, and each completed stunt counts once toward the tracked total.
Weave them into your travels instead of grinding at the end: take a run at every stunt spot you pass.
A region-by-region sweep with the exploration trophy keeps the count honest late in the run.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try each type of activity once — a first attempt is all this asks, not a win.
The trackers publish the activity types as a count of 9, which is the total the counter above uses.
Sample each activity as it unlocks — fishing, bowling and the arcade each cover one type while also feeding their own trophies.
Sampled early, this is one of the cheapest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — silver or bronze medals do not count toward this one.
The trackers put the full set at 42 challenges, which is the total the counter above uses.
Learn each range's target pattern first, then replay until the gold score falls; accuracy challenges reward a slower, deliberate pace over raw speed.
Expect this silver to take several focused sessions rather than one sitting.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — first place is required at each one, not just a finish.
The trackers put the full set at 14 locations, which is the total the counter above uses.
Learn a course's line over an attempt or two before chasing the win.
Tick locations off as you travel so none is forgotten at the end.
Win 20 different races — the total is stated in the official description.
Distinct races count: repeat wins of the same event do not advance the total.
Tour the race calendar across the map and take first place in twenty separate events.
If you lose count, the tracked total on the trophy page tells you how many distinct wins you hold.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — an outright win against him, not just taking part.
Take Cal's challenge when it becomes available and learn how the challenge is scored before chasing the win.
If you fall short, retry once the rhythm of the fishing is familiar.
The attempt also covers fishing as one of the activity types Master of None asks you to try.
Complete an arcade game — play one through to its end, once.
Walk up to an arcade cabinet, pick a game, and finish it; no score target is named in the official description.
It is the simplest activity trophy on the list, and it covers the arcade as one of Master of None's activity types.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

watch.reason: Andy's strand ends in a final mission; a strand left unfinished can be left behind as the story advances, so finish his strand as it appears.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last mission of his stranger strand.
Work the strand to its conclusion when it appears instead of parking it while the story moves on; strand finales are this list's real missable risk.
The trophy pops on that final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

watch.reason: Kenton's strand ends in a final mission; finish the strand promptly as it unlocks so story progress cannot leave it behind.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Kenton, the end of his stranger strand.
As with every stranger strand, finish Kenton's missions as they unlock so the strand is complete before the story moves past it.
The trophy unlocks on the final one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

watch.reason: Billy's strand ends in a final mission; keep the strand moving whenever a mission for him appears and see it through to the end.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Billy, the end of his stranger strand.
Keep Billy's strand moving whenever a new mission for him appears.
Seeing the strand through to its finale is what this trophy rewards.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

watch.reason: This silver needs all eight stranger strands finished, and every strand is a chain the story can move past — one abandoned strand puts the whole trophy out of reach.

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the total is stated in the official description.
Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger, and finishing a strand means playing its final mission.
The strands also feed five other trophies on this list — the five strand finales — so every strand finished advances six trophies at once.
Treat every new stranger as a priority and finish strands as you open them, rather than stockpiling them for the endgame.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

watch.reason: Randy's strand ends in a final mission; play the strand through to its last mission without letting it sit unfinished behind the main story.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Randy, the end of his stranger strand.
Play Randy's strand through to its last mission without letting it go stale behind the main story.
The trophy unlocks at the strand's end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

watch.reason: Tyrone's strand ends in a final mission; finish the strand end to end as it appears — the trophy is the finale itself.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, the end of his stranger strand.
Finish Tyrone's strand end to end as it appears.
The trophy is awarded for the strand's finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — every spot, not a sample of them.
The trackers put the full set at 18 spots, which is the total the counter above uses.
The spots are fixed locations; visit each one and use the prompt to meditate.
A sweep region by region, paired with the exploration trophy, keeps the count honest.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — one specific, unique animal, not ordinary game.
Take the hunt when Bret offers it and track that animal down.
It sits naturally alongside the stranger content, so pick it up when you meet Bret during the strand phase of the run.
The trophy pops when the hunt is delivered, not when the animal is merely found.
Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — the total is stated in the official description.
Cards are found in the world and gathered into sets; finishing any three full sets earns the trophy.
Pick up every card you pass, then check the collection screen to see which sets are closest to complete.
Hunt the gaps in the nearly-complete sets rather than starting new ones.
Perform the WAiNK interaction at 100 locations — the total is stated in the official description.
Each new location counts once toward the tracked total; repeats at the same spot do not advance it.
Spread the hundred across your whole playthrough — a few in every district you visit — instead of hunting them in one sitting.
The counter above is the reliable way to know where you stand between districts.
Complete 50 Challenges — the total is stated in the official description.
Challenges are the game's short scored tasks, offered throughout the story and free roam.
Fifty completions is a modest total if you accept them as they come rather than saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat — both halves are required: the stars, and the escape.
Raise the wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear; the trophy is about the escape, not a shootout.
Doing it deliberately — earn the stars, then drive somewhere quiet and wait — is far more reliable than hoping it happens by accident.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — one unbroken chain, inside a single wanted run.
Chain the robberies: rob, move fast to the next shop while the heat is still on, and repeat.
Pick a route of nearby shops before you start, so the wanted level never has time to drop between them.
Discover 100 vehicles — the total is stated in the official description.
A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get into it, and the tracked total grows one model at a time.
Ordinary play across the whole map puts most of the hundred in your log without trying.
Keep an eye out for rarer models parked in wealthy districts and gathered at events.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — all five inside one activation.
Line up a group of at least five enemies first, then trigger Combat Focus once and drop all five before it ends.
Crowded firefights during missions are the natural place to attempt it.
It can be retried as often as needed, so a failed attempt costs nothing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way the airport did not schedule for you.
Head to VCIA and take an aircraft or vehicle out without following any scheduled route.
The trophy pops as you depart, so no escape or distance condition follows it.
The description is a wink — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and a Rhino is the army's tank, so this trophy is earned around Rhinos.
The exact trigger is unconfirmed in the official list; what follows is the reading the guide sources work from, not a stated requirement.
Draw serious military attention in open ground until a Rhino shows up, and deal with it on its own terms.
It is a free-roam feat, repeatable whenever the army rolls out, so a failed attempt can simply be set up again.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, unseen job is the whole requirement.
Case the store first: go in quietly and keep staff and cameras from raising the alarm.
Be out before anyone knows the robbery happened.
If the alarm trips, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it.
Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — the total is stated in the official description, and the escape is part of it.
A vault job only counts if you get away, so plan the escape before you crack the vault.
A fast car placed well beats a shootout on the way out.
Five clean getaways earn the silver; the counter above tracks them.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Rob an Armored Truck and escape — as with the vaults, the getaway is part of the requirement.
Armored trucks are moving targets: stop one, take the money, and lose the heat that follows.
Have a route in mind before you make the hit, not after.
Explore all of Leonida — the whole state, area by area.
The trackers count the full map as 52 areas, which is the total the counter above uses.
An area counts once you have visited it, so a deliberate tour of the whole state, region by region, closes this out.
It pairs naturally with the meditation spots and the vehicle discoveries, which want the same tour.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation per gang is enough, but every gang must be hit.
The trackers count 9 gangs, which is the total the counter above uses.
Keep a note of which gangs you have already hit, because repeats do not advance the count.
Cross-check your note against the full list if a late operation looks familiar.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a scene trophy, not a challenge.
Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot, and take in the view.
Its name suggests doing it near the beginning of your run, while the beach is still new.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the exit is the trophy.
Get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass.
Pick any showroom, take a car, and leave through the window rather than the door.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a game of bowling there.
Visit the alley and bowl a game; no score target is named in the official description.
It also covers bowling as one of the activity types Master of None asks you to try.
The description calls it 'a partnership with mass appeal': a shared moment with your partner that draws a crowd's attention.
The exact trigger is unconfirmed in the official list; the reading below is the guide sources' interpretation, not a stated requirement.
Spend time with your partner in public places and take the joint activities the game offers the two of you.
It pops from a public partner moment rather than from any mission, so it cannot be scheduled — only set up.
Make choices — the description counts choices made across the whole game, for better or worse.
The trackers publish this as a count running to 500, which is the total the counter above uses.
Dialogue and story choices across the whole game feed the counter, so take choices whenever the game offers one instead of letting prompts pass.
It fills across a full playthrough; if it has not popped by the endgame, the tracked count tells you how far is left.

watch.reason: The description asks for success on a second attempt, so the first attempt has to fail — succeed first time and there is nothing left to retry.

steps.text: 'Second time's the charm': this trophy rewards succeeding at something on the second attempt.
That means the first attempt has to fail — a flawless first attempt leaves nothing to retry.
When a one-chance event offers you a retry, do not reload to protect a perfect record: fail it once on purpose, then succeed on the retry.
The trophy pops on the successful retry.
Witness something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') is deliberately vague, and this is the list's odd-encounter trophy.
No location or step for it is stated anywhere in the official list, so anything more specific would be invention; what follows is the guide sources' shared reading.
Explore off the beaten path, especially at night and away from the city.
Stay to watch when something unusual starts; the trophy pops for being there when it happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock a person down by striking them from a moving vehicle with a melee attack.
Drive alongside a pedestrian and swing as you pass.
Modest speed is the trick — too fast ruins the timing.
Practise on a quiet street until the swing connects cleanly.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the total is stated in the official description.
Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; route them through your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw.
The laundered total accumulates across the whole game, and the tracked figure is what the counter above mirrors.
The big scores late in the story move this counter fastest.
Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is stated in the official description.
Every shop purchase counts toward the total: clothes, vehicles, services.
Ordinary upgrading across a full playthrough covers most of it.
If you are short late in the run, one deliberate shopping round closes the gap.
Purchase all garage properties — every one of them, not most of them.
The trackers put the full set at 8 garages, which is the total the counter above uses.
Buy each garage as your money allows; the last of them is a late-game purchase.
Keep funds aside for property instead of spending everything on vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the total is stated in the official description.
When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it through the app; ten registrations is a small total.
It pairs well with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good — register the best of what you discover as you go.
